about: Voices of the Vers3Dynamics expansion. 'who' picks the ped whose mouth moves: 1 CJ, 2 Christopher, 3..5 the script's hNpc1..hNpc3, 0 nobody on screen (radio, system voices). 'tag' prefixes the subtitle for voices without a face.

CJ.voice: Carl Johnson. Original performance; do not imitate the game's actor.

CHRIS.voice: Christopher Woodyard. Calm, curious, dry; delighted by being wrong in an interesting way. Never lectures.

RAIN.voice: R.A.I.N. terminal voice. Warm, unhurried, a little formal; says 'I don't know' without embarrassment.

CERTAIN.voice: The old CERTAIN system voice. Synthetic, pleasant, overconfident.

SENTINEL.voice: SENTINEL, CERTAIN's successor. Even smoother. Even surer.

DISPATCH.voice: Police radio dispatcher. Flat, procedural, radio-filtered.

SHIELD.voice: Private security dispatcher. Clipped, corporate, eager.

NEWS.voice: TV news anchor. Measured broadcast cadence.

REX.voice: Rex Pattern, late-night talk host. Gravel, conviction, every sentence a revelation.

REXLIVE.voice: Rex Pattern in person. Same voice, less reverb.

CALLER.voice: Late-night radio caller. Sincere, a bit spooked.

TECH.voice: SureThing field technician. Tired, underpaid, not a villain.

MUSICIAN.voice: Street saxophonist, Garcia. Easygoing until accused of terrorism.

COURIER.voice: Bike courier, Downtown. Talks fast, rides faster.

PROWLER.voice: Car prowler in Chinatown. Shifty, defensive.

TEACHER.voice: Garcia high-school physics teacher. Thrilled to get real equipment.

HAM.voice: Ham-radio club president, Ocean Flats. Precise, proud of his antenna.

KID.voice: Teenage science-fair winner. Unimpressed by everything except data.

BRACKET.voice: Lyle Bracket, Ovid Venture Partners. Smiles in every sentence; means none of them.

OFFICIAL.voice: Deputy Commissioner Halvorsen, city procurement. Exhausted by permits.

CROWD.voice: A few voices from the audience.

TRUCKER.voice: Angry ice-cream van driver over a loudspeaker.
